messages:
Carmen: hey — sleepy Sunday question: anyone have ambient playlists that actually help you nap? also looking for short animated shorts (10-20 min) to watch with my kiddo. :zzz:
Noah: for ambient: Tycho, Hammock, and the 'Max Richter - Sleep' playlist on Spotify. also 'soft piano & field recordings' mixes.
Sangeeta: +1 Max Richter. I also love a playlist I call 'Calm vs Chaos' — piano, subtle synth, rain fx. For kid-friendly animated shorts: Piper, Bao, and La Luna are great (all ~5-15min).
DevBot: reminder: movie-night poll goes live next Tue in #random — cast your votes! :movie_camera:
Luca: if you want something less known, try Ólafur Arnalds ambient mixes and the album re:member. For shorts, 'The Dam Keeper' and 'World of Tomorrow' are lovely but a bit melancholic.
Priya: poll idea: ambient stream + soft subtitles watch party tonight? react :thumbsup: if yes
Carmen: :+1: love that. also any toddler-friendly recs welcome — short and funny.
Noah: for toddlers: 'Feast' (6min), 'Partly Cloudy' (6min), 'La Luna' (7min). Pixar hits again.
Sangeeta: adding 'Piper' (Pixar) — super cute. and 'The Lost Thing' (Shaun Tan) is weird-in-a-good-way for older kids.
Luca: i can drop a small playlist folder (2 hours of gentle synth loops) in the thread tonight if people want an offline copy.
Carmen: legendary, appreciate it! :heart:
Noah: tiny tip — to loop a YouTube playlist quietly: add `&loop=1` to the playlist URL, works in browser.
Priya: ok i'm seeing more thumbs than thumbs-downs. plan: ambient watch + 3 short Pixar picks? anyone opposed say now.
Carmen: no objections. thanks y'all. good naptime vibes incoming. :coffee::crescent_moon:
